name: The Name Of Jesus
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and significance of the name of Jesus as the divine Savior who alone brings salvation and authority over all spiritual forces. From His prophetic titles in Isaiah 9:6 to His given name meaning 'Savior' in Matthew 1:21, Jesus is presented as the only way to the Father (John 14:6) and the exclusive source of salvation (Acts 4:12). Believers are called to lift up His name in faith, recognizing that through it they receive forgiveness, the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38), and victory over demonic powers (Luke 10:17). This study will explore the centrality of Jesus’ name in the believer’s life and ministry.
